stat: Year-on-year growth multiple in UK web visits to ChatGPT, first eight months of 2024 vs first eight months of 2025
unit: x (multiple of prior-year UK web visits, approx. 389% growth)
applies_to: clusters: Marketing & Sales; Generative Engine Optimization
method: Recipe C (year-on-year delta) — growth multiple derived from two snapshot totals in a single primary Ofcom publication

sources_used.title: From apps to AI search: how the UK goes online in 2025

workings: Ofcom reports ChatGPT UK web visits of 1.8 billion across the first eight months of 2025, up from 368 million in the same period of 2024. Growth multiple: 1,800,000,000 / 368,000,000 = 4.891... rounded to 4.9x (approximately 389% growth). Ofcom's page states both absolute totals but does not publish the growth multiple or percentage itself.
